payload.core_mechanism_summary: Converts n to base-4 digits, builds triple (a,b,c) per digit pattern: a+=4^i, b+=2*4^i, c+=3*4^i, using stack to track permutations.
payload.rationale: Solution directly constructs the nth triple via bit manipulation and base-4 decomposition, matching 'bit_binary_representation' subtype. No backtracking or brute-force search; purely mathematical mapping.
